settings.heading: How long is delivery?
settings.row_content: 5 to 10 days from order, tracked. Orders are processed in 1 to 3 working days and ship from our supplier's warehouse overseas. Delivery is S$3.90, free over S$50.

settings.heading: Will I be charged import GST?
settings.row_content: No. Parcels under S$400 are not charged GST on import into Singapore, and our prices are what you pay.

settings.heading: My parcel has not arrived
settings.row_content: If tracking shows no movement 12 days after ordering, email us. We trace it or resend, your choice.

settings.heading: Damaged or not as described
settings.row_content: Email us within 7 days of delivery with a photo. We replace it or refund you in full. Defects that appear within 6 months are covered under Singapore's Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act.

settings.heading: Change of mind
settings.row_content: Unused items in original packaging can be returned within 14 days of delivery. You cover return postage to our Singapore address; we refund the item price once received. Delivery fees are not refunded for change of mind.

settings.heading: Is the Travel Set waterproof?
settings.row_content: No. It is a fabric mat with a soft finish. It wipes clean but is not a waterproof base.

settings.heading: Which mats are padded?
settings.row_content: Only the Knee Cushion Rug, and the cushion sits under the knee area. The Travel Set and the Everyday mat are thin by design.

settings.heading: Do any designs include the Kaaba image?
settings.row_content: Three of the six Everyday designs do. The product page says which, so you can choose a plain pattern if you prefer.

settings.heading: How do I wash them?
settings.row_content: Hand wash cold and dry in shade. The Knee Cushion Rug's cover unzips; the insert should not be machine washed.

settings.heading: Is this a Singapore store?
settings.row_content: Yes. We are a small Singapore store. Products ship from our supplier's warehouse overseas, which is why delivery takes 5 to 10 days. A person answers every email.
